name: A BUTTON
note: EXTRACTED from docs/121-the-not-done-list.md (THE LINES) by tools/extract-content.mjs (errata 250). Do not edit: change doc 121 and re-run. Out of the church's bolted collection plate. It goes on the raccoon's coat in Act III.
iconPending: reference/objects-second-pass/brief.md asks the image session for it (errata 250); the panel draws its labelled box meanwhile.

LOOK_AT.say: A black bone button, out of the church's plate. Somebody gave it in place of a dime and felt every bit as generous.
repeat: Four holes and no coat. It has been in and out of that plate for years, I should think, like a deacon.
In a poor light the Reverend would have banked it. In this town it very nearly is money.

LISTEN_TO.say: Nothing. A button says what it has to say by being missing from somewhere.
repeat: A click against the tuning fork. Bone.
Nothing. It is waiting for a coat.
